description: Use when you decided on a platform and want the executable step-by-step plan (bot/human split, human minutes, order, checklist against ban reasons, DE tax/payout notes with sources). Paid: 0.25 USD per plan; payment via x402 (USDC on Base) over HTTP: this tool returns the price, the x402 payment requirement and a free preview; pay and fetch the full plan with GET /plans/{platform} + PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Plans exist for: adobe-stock, etsy, spreadshirt, redbubble, gumroad, apify.
